examples.name: accepts a replay finding on the redemption path

narratives.title: Invite token is never consumed, so one link can be redeemed repeatedly
narratives.overview: `/api/invites/redeem` looks the invite up by token and expiry but never marks `redeemedAt`, so the same invite can be replayed and each redemption reaches `db.users.create`, creating multiple users.

examples.name: rejects a finding that only speculates about token strength

narratives.title: Invite tokens may be guessable
narratives.overview: The invite token may have low entropy because `makeInviteToken` comes from an external package the repository does not show.
